reasoning: A journalism platform requires authority, credibility, and high readability. Moving away from the 'childish' #8c52ff, we adopt a 'Modern Editorial' aesthetic. The color palette shifts to a deep, authoritative Plum/Indigo (#23103A) and Newspaper Off-White (#F7F5F2) for a mature Guardian/Financial Times feel. Terracotta accents provide LATAM warmth. Typography pairs a majestic Serif with a clean Sans for high-density reading. Layouts rely on strict grids, 1px borders, and flat surfaces instead of soft shadows.

font_families.mono: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

rules.headings: Always use tight letter spacing. Never center headings unless for a specific visual centerpiece (like a pull quote).
rules.body: Max width for article reading should be 65ch (max-w-prose). Align left.
rules.labels: Use mono font for bylines, datelines, and crypto elements. Uppercase with wide tracking.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Archival and dense. Rely on strict column grids with explicit 1px borders between content blocks instead of white space alone.

grid_patterns.homepage_hero: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 with a 8-col dominant lead story and 4-col stacked sidebar for latest news.
grid_patterns.article_layout: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 with 2-col left rail (metadata/sharing), 7-col main content, 3-col right rail (related).

cards.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (2px). Never use large radiuses.
cards.hover: Image zoom on hover within hidden overflow, subtle background shift for the text container.

buttons.primary: Solid dark plum (#23103A), white text, sharp corners. Hover: slightly darker plum.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid plum border, plum text. Hover: light gray background.
buttons.crypto: Black background, mono font, subtle yellow/gold accent (e.g. Ethereum/Bitcoin icon).

navigation.header: Solid #F7F5F2 background, hard bottom border. Sticky top. Prominent logo, clean text links, no hamburger on desktop.
navigation.footer: Dark background (#23103A), light text. Massive typography for the brand name at the bottom.

ai_human_toggle.style: Pill-shaped toggle (rounded-full) placed at the top of the article. Smooth slide animation.
ai_human_toggle.active_state: Solid purple/plum background for the active pill.

ai_search.style: Command-palette style search bar. Large, expansive, 1px border. Placeholder text: 'Ask LATAM Reportero...'

writers_directory.style: Strict bento grid of black and white portraits. Mono-font names and beats underneath.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid. Use 1px borders (border-[#23103A]/15) to separate columns and rows on the homepage to mimic a physical newspaper.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay can be applied to the background to give a physical paper feel, but keep it at 2-3% opacity.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (duotone or regular) or Lucide. Keep stroke width thin (1.5px) to match the elegant serif typography.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Links in body text should have a solid 1px underline that grows or changes color on hover. Article cards should feature a gentle image scale (1.05) on hover.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Fade in content smoothly. Use staggered entrance for lists of articles.
motion_and_interactions.ai_toggle: Use framer-motion for a smooth layoutId sliding background on the active state of the Human/AI toggle.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the #F7F5F2 background meets 4.5:1 ratio. The primary #23103A provides excellent contrast.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings should be sharp and use the accent color (#D35A3D). ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#D35A3D].

images.description: Macro shot of metallic letters/typeset. Use for 'About Us' or high-end editorial conceptual headers.
Bright modern office/newsroom. Use for general news homepage placeholders.
City and mountains. Use as placeholder for environmental or regional news.
Medellin aerial. Use as placeholder for economy or urban politics news.

Monochrome portrait of a male journalist/editor.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use the previous bright purple (#8c52ff) as it was deemed childish. Stick strictly to the deep plum (#23103A) and terracotta accent (#D35A3D).
Install and use 'Cormorant Garamond' (or 'Playfair Display') for all H1/H2/H3 headings. Use 'Inter' for body.
Implement the UI with a strict grid. On the homepage, separate sections with 1px border lines (border-border) to simulate an editorial broadsheet.
The Human/AI toggle must be clearly visible on the article page.
The Crypto donation component should use a monospace font and have a sleek, tech-forward but minimal look.
For the Writers Directory, use the provided black and white portraits in a clean grid with their names and beats (e.g., 'Politics', 'Environment') in mono font overlines.
Use standard semantic HTML sections (main, article, section) but do not use overly styled Shadcn 'Cards' with rounded corners/shadows. Strip them down to flat 1px borders.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='ai-search-input', data-testid='crypto-donate-button').
